sloka: असन्देशात्तु रामस्य तपसश्चानुपालनात् ।न त्वां कुर्मि दशग्रीव भस्म भस्मार्हतेजसा ।। ५.२०.२०।।।।
transliteration: asandeśāttu rāmasya tapasaścānupālanāt ।na tvāṁ kurmi daśagrīva bhasma bhasmārhatejasā ।। 5.20.20।।।।

translations.english: "The gods and demons were unable to withstand my power in wars fought against me. They were often shattered and defeated with their flags crushed in war.
